stem: What is one difference between the author of the letter and the speaker in the poem?

options.label: F
options.text: The author gets her inspiration to write from her feelings, while the speaker is inspired by others.

options.label: G
options.text: The author expresses a willingness to begin writing, while the speaker has difficulty transforming thoughts into words.

options.label: H
options.text: The author is content with her first attempt at writing, while the speaker continuously edits and revises.

options.label: J
options.text: The author prefers reading more than writing, while the speaker enjoys both reading and writing.
